candidates.title: Show HN: Return Ledger free portfolio TWR/XIRR tracker with AI PDF import
candidates.raw_content: Hi HN, I made a simple single-page tool that computes portfolios return / performance (TWR and XIRR), gross and net of fees and tax. It requires logging all transactions. It's client-side, with no accounts, and data lives in the browser localStorage. It started as a personal tool . I wanted a way to understand what was the return of my portfolio and of a tenanted rental property (XIRR). The experimental part is an import: you upload a broker's trade notice PDF and an LLM proposes one ledger row, which you confirm. It solves a problem I had: understanding my bank's documents, especially for bonds, at least here in Italy, where there are multiple numbers to add or subtract to get the real return. It's an alpha. I've only tested it on real documents from one Italian bank (about 40 notices, all correct on the first attempt) and on a few synthetic ones from other countries, so I'd really like to hear how it does on yours. Caveats: the PDF goes to the model provider and is neither stored nor logged by me. The AI import needs an access code, because I'm paying for the API calls out of pocket, so ask me by writing to hello@returnledger.site and I'll send one. The tracker itself works without it. I'm looking for some feedback regarding AI interpreting other brokers' documents (no need look at sensitive information, though). I'm happy to answer questions about the validation approach or the architecture (Azure Static Web Apps with a small Python function behind it). candidates.title: Cyber is going to be one of the most profound aspects of AI. We now have a tireless workforce that can hunt down, discover, patch, or attack any system and software ever created. We will use agents to identify the long standing risks in existing systems and infrastructure. Attackers will use agents to accelerate the discovery of gaps in environments. We will equally use agents to defend attacks and discover anomalous patterns to better protect our data, and much more. We’re entering a new cyber regime, and we’ll probably use 100X more tokens on this loop than we’re imagining right now, because we can scan every log, look at every line of code, look through traffic, and process data at a scale that wasn’t comprehensible before. More than ever, enterprises are going to care deeply about how they manage their networks, systems, software, data, identity, devices, and more. Agents will largely become the solution to these challenges, but they will keep everyone up in the process.
